fields.description:
As a developer, I want to authenticate with the external flight data API so that our system can retrieve real-time schedules.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given valid API credentials, when the service starts, then it connects to the flight data API.
2. Given expired credentials, when the service attempts to connect, then a clear error message is shown.
3. Given rate limiting, when the API returns 429, then the service retries with exponential backoff.
